candidate.title: Starting with Cilium 1.16 netkit is supported as a new datapath mode for Linux kernels of version 6.8 or newer
candidate.text: Starting with Cilium 1.16 netkit is supported as a new datapath mode for Linux kernels of version 6.8 or newer. Cilium still continues to rely on veth devices by default. In case of interest to experiment with netkit, please consider the performance_tuning guide for instructions. An in-place replacement of veth to netkit is not possible.

evidence.excerpt:
* Starting with Cilium 1.16 netkit is supported as a new datapath mode for Linux kernels of
  version 6.8 or newer. Cilium still continues to rely on veth devices by default. In case
  of interest to experiment with netkit, please consider the performance_tuning guide
  for instructions. An in-place replacement of veth to netkit is not possible.
